title: Claim-Review Delay Credit on Pocketwire Personal Account Purchase Protection Reimbursements
content:
A purchase protection claim on a Pocketwire Personal Account that took long to approve earns the customer a delay credit on the reimbursement.

**Rule.** The claim-review delay credit of the protection reimbursement reads the calendar days from the paid claim's report date to its approval date and is worked out on the covered amount after the coverage share: at 30 days or more it is simple interest at 18 percent a year for every one of those days, counted on an actual/365 basis; at 15 days or more but fewer than 30 it is a flat 1 percent of that amount; below 15 days there is no credit.

The days are counted from the report date to the approval date, the report date itself not counted. The interest is the amount times 18 percent times the number of review days divided by 365; the credit is not rounded on its own.

| Review days (report date to approval date) | Delay credit |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | Simple interest at 18 percent a year for every review day, actual/365 |
| 15 to 29 | A flat 1 percent of the amount |
| 14 or fewer | None |

**Worked credits (hypothetical, amount after the coverage share 400.00)**

| Review days | Credit |
|---|---|
| 14 | None |
| 15 | 1 percent of 400.00: 4.00 |
| 29 | 4.00 |
| 30 | 400.00 times 18 percent times 30 divided by 365: 5.9178… |
| 45 | 400.00 times 18 percent times 45 divided by 365: 8.8767… |
